name: quantum-singularity
description: Real-time WebGL 2 particle instrument you play with your hands and your music: on-device MediaPipe gesture recognition, Web Audio DSP and a procedural GPU particle field
author: Ibrahim Salman

scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:fast: npx playwright test tests/gesture-recognition.spec.ts tests/gesture-state.spec.ts tests/dom.spec.ts tests/accessibility.spec.ts tests/topologies.spec.ts tests/url-state.spec.ts tests/onboarding.spec.ts
scripts.test:gpu: npx playwright test tests/engineering-panel.spec.ts tests/webgl.spec.ts tests/shader-compile.spec.ts tests/camera-pipeline.spec.ts tests/visibility-suspend.spec.ts tests/audio-reactivity.spec.ts tests/audio-bands-4.spec.ts tests/csp.spec.ts
scripts.test:ci: npm run test:static && npm run test:unit && npm run test:fast && npm run test:gpu
